content: Hiza, woosa keethaa cimatara cima gididaysi, Kiristoosa waayiya markateysinne qoncanaw de7iya bonchuwa shaaketanaw de7iya taani, hinte giddon de7iya cimata zorayis.
Hinte aawatethafe garsan de7iya Xoossaa wudiya heemmite. Xoossay koyeysada dosanaape attishin, un7etidi heemmofite. Qassi miishe koshshan gidonashin, haggaazanaw de7iya lo77o qofan heemmite.
Hinte aawatethafe garsan de7iya wudiyas leemiso giditepe attishin, godatopite.
Heemmeyisata halaqay qonciya wode qolettonna boncho kallacha hinte ekana.
Hessadaka, yalagato, cimatas haaretite. Hinte issoy issuwas ashke gidite. Geeshsha Maxaafan, “Xoossay otoranchota ixees, shin ashketas aadho keehatetha immees” yaagees.
Xoossay ba wode hintena bonchana mela wolqaama Xoossaa kushiyape garsan hintena kawushite.
I hintew qopiya gisho hintena hirgisiya ubbaa iya bolla yeggite.
Hinte morkey Xalahey, mittiyaba koyidi, gaammoda gudishe hinte matara yuuyiya gisho hintena haaritenne barkite.
Alamen de7iya hinte ishati hessada waaye ekeysa eridi, ammanon minnidi, Xalahiyara eqetite.

Ba merinaa bonchuwas Kiristoos Yesuusa baggara hintena xeegida aadho keehatetha ubbaa Xoossay, guutha wodes hinte waayetidaape guye, I ba huuphen hintena shiishana, katisana, minthidi essana, xaalisana.
Merinaape merinaa gakanaw Xoossay kawoto. Amin7i.

Ammanetida ishaa gada ta ekiya Sillaase baggara ha dabdaabiya hintew qanthan xaafas. Ta hessa hintew xaafiday, hintena zoranawunne Xoossaa aadho keehatethay tuma gideysa markatanaasa. He aadho keehatethan minnidi eqite.
de7iya woosa keetha asaynne ta na7aa Marqoosi hintena, “Saro saro” yaagees.
Siiqo yeeretetha yeeretishe, issoy issuwa sarothite. Kiristoosan de7iya hinte ubbaas saroy gido. Amin7i.

footnotes.text: Babiloonen: Ha bessan Babiloone geetetiday Roome katamaa gidonna aggenna.
